verdict.rationale: Firestore docs explicitly state that Firestore caches data locally so apps can write, read, listen to, and query even while offline, implying automatic sync when connectivity returns — the core offline-first developer story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of sync-on-reconnect behavior, details on conflict resolution guarantees, and confirmation for Realtime Database (older community complaint firebase-comm-17 about lacking offline persistence is from 2016 and predates Firestore's offline support, so it's not a direct contradiction of current claims).
